annotations.text: The chat bar is the only rounded element on the screen. Everything else is square with a 3px radius, so the curve alone marks the focal point.

Motion, 9s loop:
0.0s card rises 6px into place
0.4-2.7s planner nodes advance, 1px rule fills
3.1-4.5s answer arrives one line at a time, 0.27s apart
Caret blinks 1.1s, steps(1)
All of it off under prefers-reduced-motion
Black, white and grey everywhere. Colour appears ONLY for risk and exclusions - that is what makes the risk read louder on white, not quieter.
